about.text: A flat, soft Brie-type cheese named after Nangis in Seine-et-Marne. Rennet is added to the milk, the curd is cut and hand-moulded, and it is dried for 4 to 6 days and then aged about a month in a cellar. Today it is made by Rouzaire in Tournan-en-Brie.
